notes.title: Patch notes - Version 0.2.4
notes.content: [h3]New Tiles!![/h3][p]Here's the list of changes in this new build of the demo:[/p][list][*][p][b]New tiles[/b] available! [/p][/*][*][p]A brand new [b]Charm of Magnetism[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]Added some brand [b]new sounds[/b] for the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a known bug in which the effect of the poison from the quark-charm enemy kept going even after a restart of the run.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where, if you bought an item from the shop and died, if you won the "wave" gameplay the items wasn't brought along.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some quality of life improvements, like the [b]settings panel that now is accessible from the starting menu[/b] and the "mana" bar that now is specifically tied to a weapon and has an [b]overload system.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Temporarily removed the Orbital Accumulator[/b] from the pool of weapons while we work on the design and clarity of the weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the possibility to skip the starting cinematic alltoghether.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the music tracks stacked with each other.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bugfix. [/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Thanks for the feedbacks[/u][/b]! We're greatful for the help and we hope to get back to you with the best product possible![/p][p]Also in this patch, if you play the demo and don't wishlist the game you'll be [b]doomed[/b] for life, but that's just a minor thing ;) Have a good one <3[/p]

tags.feature: Added some brand [b]new sounds[/b] for the inventory.

tags.bug: Fixed a known bug in which the effect of the poison from the quark-charm enemy kept going even after a restart of the run.
Fixed a bug where, if you bought an item from the shop and died, if you won the "wave" gameplay the items wasn't brought along.

tags.feature: Added some quality of life improvements, like the [b]settings panel that now is accessible from the starting menu[/b] and the "mana" bar that now is specifically tied to a weapon and has an [b]overload system.[/b]

tags.balance_change: [b]Temporarily removed the Orbital Accumulator[/b] from the pool of weapons while we work on the design and clarity of the weapon.

tags.feature: Added the possibility to skip the starting cinematic alltoghether.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the music tracks stacked with each other.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo
notes.content: [h3][b]Ciao Everyone![/b][/h3][p]This is the list of changes in the new build of the demo.[/p][list][*][p]Integrated [u][b]GAME SAVES[/b][/u] (yay!!). Now you can save the game and close it and you'll start from where you left the next time you want to play![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a known issue where the [u][b]viewfinder[/b][/u] of some weapons didn't work after respawning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that kept the green [u][b]poison shader[/b][/u] from the Charm Enemy if you died while being poisoned.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks a lot for the feedback, you guys are fundamental for the developing process![/p][p][/p][p]Now go test the latest version and let us know what you think! <3[/p]

tags.feature: Integrated [u][b]GAME SAVES[/b][/u] (yay!!). Now you can save the game and close it and you'll start from where you left the next time you want to play!

tags.bug: Fixed a known issue where the [u][b]viewfinder[/b][/u] of some weapons didn't work after respawning.
Fixed a bug that kept the green [u][b]poison shader[/b][/u] from the Charm Enemy if you died while being poisoned.
